messages:
marta: Heads-up: kicking off the Peregrine hardware preview cohort with Skylark. NDA is signed. Primary goals: establish baseline benchmarks, wire up telemetry for perf/regression detection, and a short joint write-up after validation. @anya can you own the benchmark matrix? @raj can you handle lab access + network? looping in @carmine_skylark for partner-side artifacts.

anya: On it. Quick Q — which models + seq lengths should I prioritize? Also do we have explicit SLOs for p50/p95 or tokens/sec targets?

raj: I’ll stand up an isolated jumpbox + VLAN and handle allowlists. I need IP ranges to allow and expected steady-state QPS. Also: which runtime image should we default to (rw-runtime:stable vs rw-runtime:quantized)?

carmine_skylark: Thanks — we’ll push sample workloads and our internal perf scripts to the shared bucket. Peregrine shows best perf with 8-bit kernels; we can also provide quantized traces. For telemetry we prefer S3 + a small metrics POST endpoint (we can send to a temporary ingest token).

anya: Proposed model set: gpt-small, opt-6b, rwd-3b. Seq lengths: 64 and 512. Targets: p50 < 30ms, p95 < 120ms on the optimized path for 64 tokens; bulk tokens/sec target ~2k tps on batch-optimized runs. If that sounds reasonable, I’ll encode into the matrix.

raj: Noted. I’ll provision `preview-lab-367` and create a short-run SSH key for @carmine_skylark. Default runtime = rw-runtime:stable; for quantized runs tell me `--quantize` and I’ll add an int8-enabled AMI. Also need to pin the GPU driver version — will share AMI details in the lab channel.

partner-bot: Provisioner: lab token created -> preview-lab-367/token-zzY2 (expires in 7 days). ACL: added 13.82.10.0/24 to allowlist.

nathan: For joint content/marketing: let's hold public mentions until we have two benchmark runs + telemetry validated. Proposed timeline = 3 weeks. If everyone agrees I’ll draft a co-author blog outline and loop in comms for an embargoed review.

anya: Plan: baseline pass by Wed, optimized + cache-run by Fri. Action list to confirm: bench matrix (anya) - Wed; infra (raj) - today; partner scripts (carmine) - EOD Tue.

carmine_skylark: Will upload perf scripts + sample payloads to the S3 token by EOD Tue. We’ll also POST a small instrumentation sample to the metrics endpoint once the token is live.

raj: FYI — Peregrine requires NVIDIA driver 540+ for our CUDA kernels. If we hit a driver mismatch we’ll fall back to CPU emulation which is much slower; I’ll pin the driver in the lab AMI and share the AMI ID.

marta: Nice. Can everyone react with :thumbsup: once your action is recorded? I’ll track progress and follow up on Thursday.
